name: Starc Concreting
topline: Locally owned family business · Warwick & surrounds
areaText: Based on Cleary Street in Warwick and working across Warwick and surrounds. Call or text Tim to talk about your job.
metaDesc: Starc Concreting: locally owned family concreters in Warwick. Silo and shed slabs, patios, driveways, pathways, exposed aggregate, site levelling and retaining walls. Call Tim on 0429 436 603.

hero.title: From garden sheds to silo slabs.
hero.lede: Starc Concreting is a locally owned family business in Warwick. Tim and the team pour driveways, patios, shed and silo slabs, and handle the site levelling and retaining walls too.

servicesSub: Big rural and industrial slabs or a small garden shed pad, it all gets the same care.

services.title: Silo & shed slabs
services.short: Slabs for silos, sheds and farm buildings.
services.long: Silo slabs and shed slabs for farms, businesses and backyards around Warwick, from major jobs down to garden sheds.

services.title: Driveways & exposed aggregate
services.short: New driveways in plain or exposed aggregate.
services.long: New driveways in plain concrete or an exposed aggregate finish.

services.title: Patios & pathways
services.short: Patios and paths around your home.
services.long: Patio slabs and pathways that tidy up the yard and stand up to the weather.

services.title: Site levelling & retaining walls
services.short: Getting the ground ready before the pour.
services.long: Site levelling and retaining walls, so your slab, driveway or patio sits right.
